entry.title: New: Bill 103 (2023) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE ON THE REAL PROPERTY TAX AGRICULTURAL CLASSIFICATION AND DEDICATED LANDS FOR AGRICULTURAL USE" The purpose of this bill is to tier the agricultural real property tax classification and require the Director of Finance to seek assistance from the Department of Agriculture with verification that lands dedicated to agriculture use comply with dedication requirements.

View on the council site
